# IT administrator network and proxy guide
<!-- Generated by scripts/render-it-admin-network.mjs from src/cli/it-admin-network.ts. Do not edit. -->
**English** | [日本語](it-admin-network.ja.md)

## Scope

This guide covers the currently supported network setup for the direct `aiand` CLI runtime: gateway access, optional update notices, corporate HTTP(S) proxies, and CA certificates. It is not a complete administrator approval page. The `aiand` CLI connects coding agents to the ai& **gateway**, its inference endpoint; `aiand` does not run a local proxy or daemon.

## Direct CLI runtime egress

Use this table only for the direct CLI process's gateway and update traffic. It is not an allowlist for installers or third-party coding agents, whose network requirements are separate.

| Origin | When the direct CLI process uses it |
| --- | --- |
| `https://api.aiand.com` | Gateway API and sign-in traffic. A profile can use different `AIAND_BASE_URL` and `AIAND_AUTH_URL` origins; in that case, allow both configured origins. |
| `https://registry.npmjs.org` | Optional interactive-terminal update notices. `AIAND_UPDATE_CHECK=0`, `NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`, or a defined `CI` prevents the check. |

Browser sign-in opens an ephemeral `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` callback listener on loopback to receive the authorization redirect. The operating system selects an available port for that sign-in. This loopback listener is not an additional Internet egress origin or a fixed inbound firewall port.

## Corporate proxy and CA certificates

`aiand` reads `HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY` (and the lowercase forms in the table) through the relaunch in `relaunchPlan`. The relaunch sets `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` and adds Node's `--use-system-ca` flag. Node handles the proxy environment configuration, including `NO_PROXY`: `NO_PROXY` is delegated to Node rather than parsed locally. Use it for origins that must bypass the corporate proxy.

| Configuration or Node.js version | Environment-proxy support |
| --- | --- |
| Proxy variables read by the CLI | `HTTPS_PROXY`, `https_proxy`, `HTTP_PROXY`, `http_proxy` |
| `v22.20.9` | No |
| `v22.21.0` | Yes |
| Safe requirement: **Node.js 22.21 or later** |  |

`aiand` trusts the operating system's system certificate store on every launch, with or without a proxy, so a company CA installed there works with no variable set; this relaunch also adds `--use-system-ca`. If the company CA is not in that store, set `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` to the path of a PEM file containing that CA before starting `aiand`. Do not work around certificate errors by disabling TLS verification. The installers and coding agents are covered in the [company root certificate guide](it-admin-certificates.md).

Pre-setting `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` bypasses `relaunchPlan`, so that path does not automatically add `--use-system-ca`. The CLI sets `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY` itself when `HTTPS_PROXY` or `HTTP_PROXY` is set, so administrators need not. If administrators set `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` themselves on Node 22, Node prints an `EnvHttpProxyAgent is experimental` warning. Adding `--disable-warning=UNDICI-EHPA` to `NODE_OPTIONS` silences only that warning. Do not use `NODE_NO_WARNINGS`, which hides every warning. On that path the CLI still adds the operating system's certificate store itself, so no CA flag is needed for a root installed there.

## Coding agents have independent traffic

Coding agents have their own HTTP clients. Variables inherited by an opened agent do not make aiand's proxy relaunch a guarantee about that agent's independent traffic. Review and configure each agent's proxy, CA, and destination requirements separately according to that agent's implementation and documentation.
